note: Real CP/M 2.2 for the Z80 machine — the redistributable ROMs that let the debug-runner boot a genuine CP/M computer (an A> prompt: DIR, TYPE, warm boot, running .COMs off a RAM-disk) in the browser, NOT the per-.COM BDOS shim. cpm22-64k.bin is Digital Research's CCP+BDOS; cpm-bios.bin is our own MIT BIOS (MC6850 ACIA console + a host RAM-disk on ports $10-$15). Both are vendored UNMODIFIED from bw-board's roms/cpm/ at the pinned sha (bwBoardPin); the boot itself is bw-board's createCpmSystem, reached through the z80 adapter's cpmSystem option. lite's attachZ80 (profile 'cpm-system') loads CCP+BDOS at 0xE400 and the BIOS at 0xFA00 and stocks drive A: with BBC BASIC.

roms.upstream: CP/M 2.2 CCP+BDOS, assembled (pasmo) from Clark A. Calkins' Z80 disassembly (cpm2-asm.zip, cpm.z80.de); MEM=64K, four 8080 A,M operands as Z80 A,(HL)
